hook.name: TokenLaunchHook
hook.description: Shared fair-launch hook serving multiple pools, each bootstrapped via hookData on the first mint. Supports per-pool optional modules: whitelist phase, anti-snipe protection, dynamic buy/sell LP-fee tax (returned as an lpFeeOverride), and liquidity lock. Governance is captured by the first LP NFT; the NFT owner controls module parameters during the launch window.
